tests.description: Skipped RED-phase browser coverage for server-authorized authenticated email preferences.
acceptance_criteria_covered: A non-essential email preference changed through its authorized authenticated surface suppresses future matching delivery.
Essential categories remain unaffected by a non-essential preference change.

tests.description: Skipped RED-phase browser coverage for the anonymous unsubscribe and re-subscribe capability.
acceptance_criteria_covered: A valid anonymous unsubscribe token changes only its allowed non-essential scope and offers a re-subscribe path.
Unknown and revoked tokens return the same minimal inactive response without tenant enumeration or authenticated-shell imports.
Rate-limited token requests return retry guidance without privileged capability or subscription disclosure.

fixture_needs: A server-seeded synthetic-sandbox tenant user with an enabled non-essential email preference and an essential email category.
A release-control fixture that admits only synthetic sandbox delivery and never real recipients.

Public unsubscribe fixtures containing active, revoked, unknown, and pre-rate-limited opaque tokens; fixture setup must retain plaintext only in the browser fixture and persist SHA-256 hashes in storage.
A deterministic server-side delivery assertion fixture for the preference opt-out, covered by the integration suite rather than these browser tests.
summary: Generated 5 intentionally skipped failing E2E tests for authenticated email-preference and anonymous unsubscribe journeys; all delivery fixtures are synthetic sandbox only.
